text: 🎉 "OH! One more thing! We noticed some of you have been... traveling together! In little groups! How ORGANIC! How INEFFICIENT!"

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Highbeam Deer: MOVE, don't stare. When it goes still, the beam is coming — MOVE, don't stare at the light. Anything beats standing there: the freeze means it is already aiming. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hummice: Bellow at the choir. The Swarm Hum stacks while you stand in it — but the hum needs the choir. SHOUT and the bellow scatters it. Raw noise, no words, all lungs. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Anaconda Empress: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (You did the thing —

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Cliffhanger: Go for the eyes. When it lunges, strike the EYES or the soft palate inside the mouth — the armored hide shrugs off everything else. Never fight it in the water; that's its studio. On land, get beside it: it turns like a bus. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Static: Don't walk toward the voice. Resist the lure: don't move toward the crying. Two rounds of refusal and the act breaks — it's a radio, exposed and furious, and it has to re-spool before it rushes. That's your window. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Paparazzo: Break line of sight before the fourth shot. Four shots is the whole fight — break line of sight before the fourth and the model starves. The EXCLUSIVE cannot be dodged, only prevented: move while the lens steadies. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Static Kite: Leave the marked square. The mark is generous — two full beats to leave the square. When it dips to transmit it's at melee height and takes +50%: that's the only window. Leave the square, then punish the dip. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Union Rep: Kill the rep first. It does not fight, it ORGANIZES — kill the rep before WALKOUT or the stomp lands as one. First blood on the rep, every time. Every ally it rallies hits +3 harder. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nostalgia: Keep moving during the spell. The Home Movies beam needs your EYES — keep moving during the SPELL beat and the picture can't hold you. The screen burns brightest just before it fires: that's your two-turn warning. Or break its concentration outright: a stun or shout w

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Spool: Feed it nothing. It records your strikes and plays them back. Give it waits and heals while it records and the replay is silence. (Onni lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Do something you have never done — It only knows your past — every move you ever made, worn like your face. Do something you have never done and it has nothing to wear. Novelty is literally the weapon; repetition is the uniform it dresses you in.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sunbasker: Never let it finish basking. Its scales go molten gold as it charges — hit it while it basks and the charge dies unspent — a stun, a shout, a thrown rock, anything that breaks its focus. Interruptible: the bask is a ritual, and rituals need quiet. Don't let it finish.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Moderator: Wait — silence is a verb it can't moderate. It mutes the verb you lean on — strike or move, whichever you use more. But silence is a verb the algorithm cannot moderate: WAIT and its attention slides off your habits. (You did the thing — and it worked.)
👄 The Eater gorges on the field — +0 damage growth. (Alejandra should have poisoned the meal.)
📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
